selection_rule.exclude_prior_target_ways: Exclude every target way in the prior active-ray, fresh four-target, reference-portal, and node-credential sources.
selection_rule.exclude_prior_items: Exclude every item in those sources plus both Le Viviani reference items.
selection_rule.within_target: Choose the eligible strict-orientation DIRECT item nearest 30 metres, tie by item ID.
selection_rule.panel: Sort eligible targets within source city by target-way ID and item ID, then select round-robin over sorted city names while requiring unique target ways, items, collections, and at least three cities.
forbidden_inputs: selected full, SD, thumbnail, tile, or derived pixels
OCR, CLIP, DINOv2, or any learned-model output on selected images
selected-image top-1 score, margin, or open-set decision

open_set_contract_frozen_before_pixels.calibration_source: The four source-extended positive episodes in l10_panolab_component_router_result_v1.json; all were consumed Development before this negative source was selected.
open_set_contract_frozen_before_pixels.threshold_rule: Set each threshold to the minimum corresponding value across the four correct positive-roster queries, with no negative examples and no search over alternative statistics.
open_set_contract_frozen_before_pixels.accept: Emit APPEARANCE_SEARCH_PRIORITY_CANDIDATE only if both the top-1 facade-fingerprint score and top-1-minus-runner-up margin meet their frozen minima; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
open_set_contract_frozen_before_pixels.semantics: This is a tiny positive-calibrated selective Development rule. It is not conformal calibration, does not control FDR, and has no distribution-shift guarantee.
